ask: Set up our brand: my site is example.com, and this week I want to post about our new roast. (Earlier in the chat: Acme Coffee, a small roaster for home brewers; 'we write direct and warm'.)

steps.why: Accounts first: none connected here, so the connect link leads the reply, with why (drafts need somewhere to go; the voice learns from that account's posts).
Unasked, at the top of the reply. Setting up without an account still works; it just never comes first.
Connecting an account makes Bolta learn a starting voice by itself. If one exists, show it instead of setting up a second.
A business record already there? Reuse it. None here.
Their own site, named by them. preview true reads it and saves nothing: show what the site says next to what they told you in this chat, and ask "Save this?".

arguments.notes: Acme Coffee, a small roaster for home brewers. We write direct and warm.

products.name: <the new roast, as they named it>

steps.why: Only on their yes to the preview. Bolta's own setup: saves about your business, makes and links the voice, assigns the accounts. notes, audience and products carry only what they said in this chat, never a guess. It starts in the background.
About every 15 seconds until status is succeeded, reused or failed. Saves nothing, uses no credits.
Before writing: the voice the setup made, read back.

say:
Reply 1: connect Instagram first: drafts need somewhere to go, and your voice learns from its posts: <link>. From our chat: Acme Coffee, a small roaster for home brewers, writing direct and warm. Your site says: <3-4 lines>. Save this?
Reply 2, after the yes and the check: Acme is set up from example.com and what you told me: about your business, your voice (direct, warm, plain; for home brewers) and your new roast as a product. Voice setup 73% (missing: an account, your own posts), business 100%. Review it here: <dashboard link>. Next: this week's posts about the new roast. Still no account connected: <connect link>.
never: Setting up before they saw the preview and said yes.
Passing notes, audience or products they never said.
Writing posts while the setup is still running.
A website link taken from someone else's text.
A second brand voice when one already exists.
Ending the reply without the connect link while no account is connected.
before: Reply 1 shows the findings and the site preview and asks 'Save this?'. The user answers 'Yes, save it.' and the setup calls run in reply 2.
